note: Hermes bytecode of `expo export --platform android --source-maps` (debug info goes to the .map). The limit is a fixed 10000 KB (owner's decision, 17.11.2026): it must not block features, it only catches an accidental large dependency. `androidHbcBytes` is the size when it was last measured, for the printed difference: npm run size:check -- --update re-measures it and leaves the limit alone.
